slots.name: assault duration
slots.sentence: The man, who the BBC is calling James, said three intruders forced their way into their Solihull home before launching an assault which lasted 45 minutes.

slots.name: attacker identification
slots.sentence: The three attackers are all thought to be in their late teens or early 20s and one of them was a black male with a scar under his left eyebrow.

slots.name: occurrence date
slots.sentence: His wife, who also did not want to be named, described the attack that happened in December last year as "horrific" and said she feared James had been killed when he was unresponsive on the floor.

slots.name: attacker identification status
slots.sentence: Police have yet to identify the attackers.

slots.name: accomplice payout
slots.sentence: James said before they left, he heard the man on the video call tell his accomplices: "You can have 10 grand each but I am taking the rest."

events.label: Crimestoppers reward for Solihull crypto robbery

slots.name: reward amount
slots.sentence: Crimestoppers are offering a £10,000 reward for information in the attack, which was captured on home security footage and is being investigated by the police.
